title: Siren of the Haunted Shore
description: A surreal woman stands in a windswept coastal landscape, her lower body dissolving into a translucent dress containing a flooded village with glowing houses. Her flowing hair merges with dark storm clouds, from which multiple screaming faces emerge alongside golden leaves.
prompt: A surreal ethereal woman stands on a stormy coast at dusk, her Victorian-style dress transforms into a translucent flooded village with glowing houses inside the fabric. She holds an old lantern in one hand while the other rests on her chest, her hair blends into dark swirling storm clouds from which multiple open-mouthed screaming faces emerge, turbulent sea and tall grass in the background, dramatic moody lighting, detailed fantasy painting
